intent: Compatibility alias for create-frontend-design. Use only in create/explore modes; never as the primary procedure under conform or adapt.
steps: Resolve design_mode from the Work Unit design_binding
If design_mode is create or explore, follow create-frontend-design
If design_mode is conform or adapt, refuse and switch to implement-approved-design or adapt-approved-design
Never replace an authoritative mockup with a self-invented aesthetic direction
invariants: Alias only — creative defaults must not override Design Authority
Authoritative references win over agent creativity
